questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Richard wore a broad belt with shiny buckles.

options.text: A broad belt with shiny buckles had been worn by Richard.
A broad belt with shiny buckles was wear by Richard.
A broad belt with shiny buckles wore Richard.
A broad belt with shiny buckles was worn by Richard.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'A broad belt with shiny buckles was worn by Richard.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Richard'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'A broad belt with shiny buckles'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'wore' will be changed into 'was worn'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__* A broad belt with shiny buckles was worn by Richard.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

__
 
• ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• उदाहरण:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'Richard' है।​
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का object 'A broad belt with shiny buckles' है।
 
• Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
 
• 'wore' को 'was worn' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में, 'by' preposition जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed select ‘No improvement required’.**

__A need of an__ hour is to provide employment to the youth of the country.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The need of the'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. Hence, the underlined part should be changed.
 
• Here,** 'The need of the' **should be used instead of **'A need of an'.**
 
• The given sentence is referring to a specific point of time. Hence, we have to use the definite article '**the**' here.
 
 
• *Example: **The** dog that bit me ran away.*
 
 
 
• ​**“Need of the hour”** means at an unspecified point in time (“hour”), there is a thing that everybody wants or must have (“need”). 
 
• While an **“hour”** usually refers to the point of time that’s exactly sixty minutes long, **“hour”** **in this phrase is not the same**.
 
• Instead, we’re just referring to an unspecified time frame, and there’s no telling when or if that time frame will end.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence__**__:__** *****The need of the** hour is to provide employment to the youth of the country.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। अत: रेखांकित भाग को बदल देना चाहिए।
 
• यहाँ, **'A need of an'** के स्थान पर **'The need of the'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य एक विशिष्ट समय की बात कर रहा है। इसलिए, हमें यहां definite article '**the**' का उपयोग करना होगा।
 
 
• *Example: **The** dog that bit me ran away.*
 
 
 
• "Need of the hour" का अर्थ है समय में एक अनिर्दिष्ट बिंदु ("hour"), एक ऐसी चीज है जो हर कोई चाहता है या होना चाहिए ("आवश्यकता")।
 
• जबकि एक "hour" आमतौर पर उस समय के बिंदु को संदर्भित करता है जो ठीक साठ मिनट लंबा होता है, इस वाक्यांश में "hour" समान नहीं होता है।
 
• इसके बजाय, हम केवल एक अनिर्दिष्ट समय सीमा की बात कर रहे हैं, और यह नहीं बताया जा रहा है कि वह समय सीमा कब समाप्त होगी।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4 **है।

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.

B. Older people and children remain glued to it.

C. It has become a great source of entertainment for all.

D. TV has become a powerful medium these days.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**DBCA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a **Para Jumble.**
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually **an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. **
 
• **Sentence D **will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement. It is talking about how powerful a medium TV has become these days.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the next sentence because it further explains** Sentence D. **It tells us that older people and children watch TV all the time.
 
• **Sentence C **will be the next sentence because older people and children watch TV a lot, hence, it is a great source of entertainment for them and others.
 
• At last,** sentence A **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:-
 
 
• **D**: TV has become a powerful medium these days.
 
• **B**: Older people and children remain glued to it.
 
• **C**: It has become a great source of entertainment for all.
 
• **A**: It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *TV has become a powerful medium these days. Older people and children remain glued to it. It has become a great source of entertainment for all. It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. “Buy sweet apples, or none at all”, he instructed his servant.

B. A rich man sent his servant to an orchard to buy some apples.

C. The servant asked, “How am I to know that all of them are sweet if I taste just one?”

D. The owner of the orchard said to the servant, “All my apples are sweet. Try one”
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The first statement in the sequence should be **B** because it is introducing the subject **'rich man.'**
 
• A follows B because it is talking about the instructions given by the rich man to his servant.
 
• D follows A because it is talking about the reaction of the servant.
 
• **C** provides a conclusion to the story.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is 'BADC.'
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:

 ​

B. A rich man sent his servant to an orchard to buy some apples.

A. “Buy sweet apples, or none at all”, he instructed his servant.

D. The owner of the orchard said to the servant, “All my apples are sweet. Try one”

C. The servant asked, “How am I to know that all of them are sweet if I taste just one?”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 

 

 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
• अनुक्रम में पहला कथन **B** होना चाहिए क्योंकि यह 'अमीर आदमी' विषय का परिचय दे रहा है।
 
• **A, B** का अनुसरण करता है क्योंकि यह अमीर आदमी द्वारा अपने नौकर को दिए गए निर्देशों के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• **D, A** का अनुसरण करता है क्योंकि यह नौकर की प्रतिक्रिया के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• **C **कहानी को निष्कर्ष प्रदान करता है।
 
• इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर 'BADC' है।

questions.question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

The food / in the new eatery / is much best than / the one in RK Puram.
questions.solution: The correct answer is **'is much best than****.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The error lies in part **'is much best than'** of the sentence. • **Comparative adjectives** are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher). • They are used in sentences where two nouns are compared, in this pattern: • **Noun (subject) + verb + much + comparative adjective + than + noun (object)**. • **Example**: *The rock flew **much higher than** the roof.* • Therefore, the use of **'much best than'** in the sentence should be replaced by 'much better than' to make it grammatically correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is 'is much best than.' • ​Correct sentence__: *The food in the new eatery **is much better than** the one in RK Puram.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • When two items/people are compared, a comparative degree is used by putting ‘er’ to the adjective word in association with the word ‘than’. • In some cases ‘more’ is used. • Example: *She is smarter than her sister. She is more cheerful than her sister.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • त्रुटि part 'is much best than' में निहित है।​ • Comparative adjectives उन दो वस्तुओं के बीच अंतर की तुलना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जिन्हें वे संशोधित करते हैं (बड़ा, छोटा, तेज, उच्च)। • उनका उपयोग उन वाक्यों में किया जाता है जहाँ दो संज्ञाओं की तुलना इस पैटर्न में की जाती है: • Noun (subject) + verb + much + comparative adjective + than + noun (object). • Example: *The rock flew much higher than the roof.* 37:Tdae, The correct answer is option 2) i.e., **'****Lethargic****​'**.
